capabilities: Chat with an AI agent about vault notes
Let the agent search, read and edit notes through an MCP server
Review and undo agent edits in Ask, Plan or Auto mode
Add, toggle and remove local or remote MCP servers
extras: Requires Obsidian Desktop 1.7.2+; the plugin asks for shell, filesystem and clipboard permissions, downloads the agy binary if missing, and runs only a loopback MCP server with a bearer token; no telemetry. Settings and conversations carry over from the old Anti-dian id, but custom hotkeys must be reassigned.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hold a conversation with an AI agent that can act directly on the notes in a vault.

relations.evidence: Enabled Obsidian plugins whose ID ends with -antidian (such as Excalidraw MCP, excalidraw-mcp-antidian) are detected automatically
Up to 1.0.1 the plugin was listed as Anti-dian (id anti-dian).

summary: Chat sidebar that runs Google's Antigravity CLI agent to search, read and edit vault notes, with reviewable inline edits and MCP tool servers.
